scope: Descriptive existing-data audit only; no new timings, causal test, significance test or excluded samples

per_sample_position.warning: Exploratory position summaries retain every sample. Positions mix arena growth, allocation and elapsed context; they are not replacements for the predeclared estimator.

source_derived_capacity_hypothesis.status: Expected doubling trajectory, not observed capacities; confirm with separate allocator/capacity probe.
source_derived_capacity_hypothesis.note: Three growth-heavy and four growth-free positions can make median-of-seven equal the largest growth-free value, conditional on their ordering. No samples are excluded.

limits: Two timing phases and repeated seeds are retained as groups, not independent workload draws.
Churn seed and within-process arm order are coupled; these strata cannot isolate input shape from arm position.
Microbenchmark has no random seed; pair index modulo3 is not a seed and is not analyzed as one.
Control variability is descriptive; it neither cancels a regression nor establishes noise.
